instruction: Lift the wireless mouse with left and right buttons and drop it on the Green mat.

source.instruction: Lift the wireless mouse with left and right buttons and drop it on the Green mat.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the mouse, which was at x = -22 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm above mouse at (-22, 0, 94), point down, rotate yaw to match mouse orientation.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+8, +19, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -1, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm towards mouse grasping height at z = 85.5.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -1, 85) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm further to z = 77.5 and close gripper to grasp mouse.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +1, -8) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, 0, 78) opening 0.80; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift mouse up to z = 88 to clear table surface.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -0, 87) opening 0.81; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Translate left arm over green mat to (-10, -10, 88).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+12, -9, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-10, -10, 88) opening 0.82; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate mouse orientation and lower slightly to prepare for release.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -3) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the mouse

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-10, -10, 85) opening 0.82; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower mouse to table level z = 78.5 and open gripper to release.
